children: India’s technology sector has powered growth in the world’s fastest-growing large economy, but uneven progress has left some strengths vulnerable, according to Bloomberg.

Bangalore became India’s tech capital by attracting global investment and building a deep talent pool, but infrastructure and policies have struggled to keep pace with the expansion. The program also looks at whether Hyderabad can overtake Bangalore as India’s leading tech city and Blackstone’s investment in Royal Challengers Bengaluru.

title: India’s Growth Faces Infrastructure Strains as Bangalore Tech Boom Draws Capital
